responsibility: Provides shared driver-layer utilities for Cranelift codegen, especially predeclaring monomorphized functions with the correct signatures and linkage before per-item codegen, and bridging Cranelift’s internal pass timing hooks into rustc’s self-profiler infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one sits above item lowering and coordinates backend execution: it predeclares monomorphized items in the module with linkage/signatures and adapts Cranelift pass timing to rustc profiling. It does not define ABI rules, emit DWARF structures, lower individual intrinsics, or house optimization transforms.
